explanationMd: Expand to 3−3i+2i−2i squared. Since i squared is −1, the real terms total 5 and the imaginary terms total −i.

distractorRationale.b: The imaginary terms sum to negative i, not positive i.
distractorRationale.a: This does not distribute both binomials.
distractorRationale.c: This uses i squared as positive one when evaluating the last product.
